description: Declaration of the Human Binding interface for the Console Service first slice (services/console/CHARTER.md, 'First slice: the owner's judgement surface'). A declaration only: it names the operations the binding invokes, the manifest operation and SPEC.md transition each resolves to, and what the binding must expose under bindings/README.md. No schema exists for this declaration yet; keys are lower_snake_case like the console record contracts. It contains no implementation and realizes nothing.

realizes.transition_contract_projection: contracts/kernel-transitions.json (rebuildable projection of the SPEC.md table; SPEC.md is authoritative)

realization_target.source: ENGINEERING.md, Minimal reference stack, row 'Local surface' (Python API and CLI; human and model bindings use the same kernel operations)
realization_target.note: The smallest Human Binding the owner can actually use. It is not a graphical interface claim and it adds no transport.

operations.result: operator-session with actor_kind HUMAN, binding_id equal to this interface_id, lifecycle OPEN; one receipt
operations.note: Console proposal; no SPEC.md transition row names session opening. Opening a session grants nothing.

operations.result: judgement-request records with lifecycle QUEUED whose addressed_to is the session's operator_id, read from the record path and not from notification records or any projection-view; one receipt with effect_class RECORD_LOCAL
operations.note: CONS-008 read. The pending list is a manifest read operation of the human-binding and model-binding ports, a CHARTER.md proposal not yet defined by SPEC.md. A setting, session state, unread cursor, or dashboard role never changes the membership of the list.

operations.result: one judgement-request record with its address and digest, question resolved from question_address and checked against question_digest, evidence_addresses, decision_ref, operation_id, loop_mode, required_authority_type, capability, scope, lifecycle, standing, and resolution_id; one receipt
operations.note: Read only. The rendered question must reproduce the bytes at question_address.

operations.commit: preserve history; add RATIFIED event. The judgement-resolution record is written with resolver_kind HUMAN, resolver_grant_id naming the grant checked, interface_id equal to this interface_id, and receipt_id; the judgement-request reaches lifecycle RESOLVED with resolution_id by an appended event; the conditioned operation receives a successor receipt whose prior_receipt_id names its UNRESOLVED receipt, the same id the judgement-resolution records as unresolved_receipt_id
operations.note: CONS-009 and CONS-002. The binding presents the decision and rationale; the kernel performs the ratify transition and the authority check. The binding holds, infers, and widens no grant. Whether the refusal reason_code for a MODEL attempt is AUTHORITY_REFUSED or a console-specific name is undecided (CONS-002).

operations.result: notification lifecycle ISSUED to ACKNOWLEDGED by an appended event; acknowledged_at set; one receipt
operations.note: Console proposal. Acknowledging a notification changes nothing about the record its source_address names.

operations.result: one Receipt in the SPEC.md Receipt shape: receipt_id, event_id, event_type, actor_id, interface_id, authority_grant_ids, precondition_results, effect_class, outcome, reason_code, emitted_record_addresses, observed_evidence_addresses, prior_receipt_id, created_at, receipt_digest; one receipt for the read
operations.note: Read only. A refusal is shown as its receipt, never as an error string alone.

operations.result: operator-session lifecycle OPEN to CLOSED by an appended event; closed_at set; one receipt
operations.note: Console proposal. Closing a session withdraws no pending judgement request and resolves none.

state.must_expose: the operator session lifecycle; each pending judgement request's lifecycle, loop_mode, and standing; the outcome of the conditioned operation's current receipt (UNRESOLVED while QUEUED); each notification's lifecycle
state.never: a projection-view, a notification standing in for its source record, or the binding's own memory

choices.must_expose: the legal operations for the current actor and the required inputs of each (SPEC.md Interface parity); for resolve-judgement, the decision vocabulary ACCEPTED, STRUCK, DEFERRED and the optional rationale
choices.never: an operation the manifest does not declare, or a decision value the record contract does not admit

authority.must_expose: before an attempt, the authority the resolution will check: required_authority_type JUDGEMENT, capability resolve-judgement, and scope the request's request_id, read from the request; after an attempt, the grant named in the receipt's authority_grant_ids and the resolution's resolver_grant_id
authority.never: a grant held, inferred, cached, or widened by the binding, a session, a setting, or a dashboard role

provenance.must_expose: the request's address and digest, question_address and question_digest with the rendered question checked against them, evidence_addresses, decision_ref, requester_id and requester_kind; a notification's source_address and source_digest; the rationale_address and rationale_digest of a resolution
provenance.never: a paraphrase presented as the question, or evidence summarized without its addresses

receipts.must_expose: for every invocation, the receipt by receipt_id with outcome, reason_code, interface_id equal to this interface_id, authority_grant_ids, effect_class, and prior_receipt_id; a refusal as its REFUSED receipt and reason_code
receipts.never: a success message without a receipt, or a receipt the binding composed itself

parity.model_binding: A Model Binding over the model-binding port reads the same records as typed JSON structure: the same judgement-request with the same address and digest (CONS-008), the same receipts and reason codes. Lists differ in rendering only and are compared by digest.
parity.source: SPEC.md Interface parity; bindings/README.md parity proof; services/console/conformance/002-model-cannot-resolve-judgement.yaml

forbids: holding, inferring, or widening a grant
deriving the pending list from notifications or a projection-view
treating the binding's own report as observation
any effect class other than RECORD_LOCAL

admission.statement: This file declares an interface; it does not realize one. No implementation of this binding is admitted until the shared transition contract is frozen (STATUS.yaml O10) or Bdo explicitly authorizes a provisional Human Binding target for the Console Service (STATUS.yaml O18), per the admission rule in bindings/README.md and the protected boundary no_runtime_code_before_logical_spec_and_defeating_fixtures. This declaration contains no code, and bindings/console/ holds no Python module.
